memorial.name: Natalie
memorial.epitaph: Well. The wild. 58 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Kwame
memorial.epitaph: Well. Contest. 5 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Bianca
memorial.epitaph: Well. A stranger. 1 day. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Megan
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: A stranger. 2 days of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.

memorial.name: Avery
memorial.epitaph: Oh no. Oh no no. The wild — 15 days of me, and if you're reading this, it's yours now! The notes are good, I promise, keep going!

memorial.name: Henry
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. Contest. 15 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Xavier
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: Contest. 6 days of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.
